title: Oily Velvety Spanish Seafood Fideua
description: A festive and rich Galician dish featuring seafood and a unique twist on traditional fideua, using english muffins to create a velvety texture, and emulsification for a smooth and oily sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the shrimp, mussels, and clams, and cook until the seafood is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, lemon juice, and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the seafood is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.
While the seafood is cooking, toast the english muffin pieces in the oven until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
To emulsify the sauce, slowly pour it into a blender or food processor while running, then return it to the skillet.
Add the toasted english muffin pieces to the skillet and stir to combine with the seafood and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
